title: gnaphalium bellidioides
intro: Gnaphalium bellidioides, commonly known as daisy bush, is a flowering shrub native to Australia. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Gnaphalium bellidioides include antimicrobial, antiviral, and antioxidant activities, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
